items.question: Do I need a website?
items.answer: No. We can build it from scratch with CUSTOM or include it within FULL.

items.question: Do I have to prepare the content?
items.answer: No. Depending on the contracted product, CAT CODE can create the content needed for your digital presence.

items.question: How many posts does WEEKLY include?
items.answer: All WEEKLY plans include 5 posts per week.

items.question: How many posts does SOCIAL include?
Can I hire just one part?
items.answer: Yes. You can hire CUSTOM, WEEKLY, or SOCIAL independently.

items.question: Can I change plans?
items.answer: Yes. You can change plans according to your business needs.

items.question: Is the domain included?
items.answer: No. The domain is contracted and renewed under the client's name.

items.question: Which social media do you manage?
items.answer: SOCIAL is designed for Facebook and Instagram.

items.question: Do you publish for us?
items.answer: Yes. Publishing is included in SOCIAL.

items.question: Do you do advertising?
items.answer: No. Advertising campaigns are not included in SOCIAL.

items.question: Do you respond to messages and comments?
items.answer: It is not part of the standard SOCIAL service.

items.question: Do you also do stories?
items.answer: They are included according to the contracted plan.
